chars.ILYAS: ILYAS: a slim 18-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a stern Moroccan man in his 50s with a grey mustache and glasses, wearing a light blue shirt and dark navy trousers
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a Moroccan woman in her 40s wearing a burgundy hijab and a long beige djellaba

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Rabat high school classroom, ILYAS smiles proudly holding up a graded exam paper with a big good mark circle (no readable text), classmates behind him, bright daylight

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Outside a Rabat school, ILYAS stands shocked in front of a results board covered with blurred paper lists (no readable text), hands on his head, other students blurred in background

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan family living room with sedari sofas, FATHER shouts angrily pointing at ILYAS who looks down ashamed, tense evening light

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the front door of a Rabat apartment, MOTHER gestures angrily and tearfully while ILYAS walks out carrying a sports bag over his shoulder

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS sits alone by the window of a Moroccan intercity bus, sports bag on his lap, looking out sadly at a summer countryside road

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: End of summer, ILYAS walks back into a Rabat street of white apartment buildings pulling his bag, evening sun, uneasy face

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At night ILYAS walks alone down a dim Rabat alley under a streetlamp, hood up, looking back over his shoulder secretively

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS freezes in the doorway of his messy bedroom: drawers pulled out, clothes thrown everywhere, FATHER kneels searching his open backpack and MOTHER holds his phone, both turn to look at him with suspicion
